title: Don't waste your time
text: Don't waste your time. Returned immediately. Doll falls forward, front of kimono unglued from base. The sash in back is lined with oriental paper which shows thru the fabric, head piece cheap. Too bad because she could've been a lovely elegant addition to my curio cabinet.
